responsibility: Provides the autogenerated documentation URL mapping for RL78 target options declared in rl78.opt. This file associates individual -m option names and aliases such as mcpu, mmul, mg10/mg13/mg14, msim, and related switches with their anchor locations in the GCC manual, so the generated option metadata can point diagnostics, help, or tooling at the correct RL78-Options documentation entries; it is a documentation-index companion to rl78.opt rather than a file that changes code generation semantics.
